'''KFUM-Kameratene Oslo''' is the sports branch of the local [[YMCA]] in [[Oslo]], [[Norway]]. It has departments for [[association football]], [[futsal]], [[volleyball]], and [[track and field]]. The football team currently plays in [[Eliteserien]] from 2024, the top tier of the [[Norwegian football league system]] after promotion from [[Norwegian First Division]] in [[2023 Norwegian First Division|2023]].

The club was founded on 1 January 1939, the clubs traditional base are in downtown Oslo. Today the team plays its matches at [[KFUM Arena]], located at [[Ekebergsletta]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.a-laget.com/?q=historie|title=Historie|publisher=KFUM-Kameratene Oslo|language=no|access-date=24 July 2010|archive-date=3 December 2010|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101203111022/http://www.a-laget.com/?q=historie|url-status=live}}</ref>"}}
